caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure with light skin and blonde hair styled in waves. She is wearing a full-length gown in a shade of pink or magenta, adorned with a pattern of small black floral shapes throughout the fabric. The sleeves are three-quarters length and also detailed with the black pattern, ending just below the elbows. Over her shoulders, she wears a black lace shawl. Around her waist is a black belt or sash. She is holding a black lace accessory, possibly a fan or a small muff, in her left hand. She is also adorned with a necklace featuring a floral motif. The figure stands against a plain, light background with no additional elements or scenery. The drawing is signed “Eugene Croe” in red at the bottom right corner.
title: Doll - "Leta"
